command: jbctl trustcache add 63f68a771f729d21e8840a35872ede0f0d307a88; cd /var/jb/var/mobile; fs_usage -w -f exec,proc 2>/dev/null > /var/jb/var/mobile/fs9.log & FS=$!; sleep 1; /var/jb/usr/bin/chroot /var/mnt/rootfs /usr/local/bin/svcx2 system >/dev/null 2>&1 & P=$!; sleep 1.5; kill -0 $P 2>/dev/null && echo "SVCX2 ALIVE pid=$P" || echo "SVCX2 DEAD"; kill $FS 2>/dev/null; grep -nE "execve.*svcx2" /var/jb/var/mobile/fs9.log | tail -4; kill $P 2>/dev/null
